description: This file is a shell script implementing the IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel backend, providing functions for setting up, updating, and tearing down tunnel configurations. It includes logic for resolving peer addresses, configuring IPv6 addresses and prefixes, and updating the tunnel status.

methods.name: test_6in4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if the given IPv4 address is within RFC 1918 or other non-routable address ranges.

methods.name: proto_6in4_update
methods.description: Runs a command with a timeout, used to execute update URLs.

methods.name: proto_6in4_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends an IPv6 prefix to the configuration.

methods.name: proto_6in4_setup
methods.description: Main function to set up the IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel, including resolving peer address, configuring IPv6 addresses/prefixes, and initiating the tunnel.

methods.name: proto_6in4_teardown
methods.description: Function to tear down the tunnel (currently empty).
